what_i_see: At centre only a very faint, diffuse smudge ~3" across slightly W of centre; nothing compact. A spiked G=17.5 star lies ~15" S and a compact galaxy pair ~6" SE. VIS-only: colour panel is pure blue, so uninformative.
most_likely: A faint low-surface-brightness background galaxy or noise fluctuation.
against_it: Signal is marginal; could be faint scattered light, but the nearby star is too faint to make strong ghosts.
decisive_test: Deeper or repeat VIS imaging: a persistent smooth detection at the same position confirms a faint galaxy.
catalogue_notes: Gaia DR3 star G=17.5 (parallax 0.58 mas) at 14.7" (the spiked star). Nearest NED WISEA J044622.32-511016.6 ~20"; SIMBAD DES J044621.77-511027.6 (cluster galaxy) 27". No DR8 photo-z within 12". No match in Jacobs+2019, Huang+2020/2021 (cone 10"; Rojas+2022 query unvalidated).
